helpers.doc: /** 🧮️ The tool job source evaluator and the exact bounded first step proof builder shared by the proof catalog phases. */

items.doc: Evaluates the tool job rows that remain unmigrated for a map of owner sources.
Builds the exact bounded first step proof source of one tool for an owner file and controller.

files.doc: /** 🧾️ The interactive job evaluation fixtures, the proof catalog evaluation checks and the admission order and bounded preparation checks. */

phases.name: interactiveJobEvaluationFixtures
phases.doc: Runs the fixture sources that must leave at least one unmigrated tool job row and returns them for the final count.

phases.name: proofCatalogEvaluationChecks
phases.doc: Checks scan then monolith rows, duplicate owners, valid, typed and shared catalogs, executable owners, qualified schemas and forged proof rows.

phases.name: admissionOrderAndBoundedPreparationChecks
phases.doc: Checks reserved route bypass, decode before lookup, contract mismatch, cancellation ownership, qualified proof order, alias fallback, reserved terminals and bounded full operation preparation.

files.doc: /** 🧯️ The process global payload store inventory, the actor progress overlay and the mounted fem2d session checks. */

phases.name: globalPayloadStoreInventoryChecks
phases.doc: Checks the process global payload owner inventory and the exact shared fixed authority exemption.

phases.name: actorProgressOverlayChecks
phases.doc: Checks the actor, shard and wgpu job progress overlay sources and every single-edit mutation of them.

phases.name: fem2dMountedSessionChecks
phases.doc: Checks the mounted fem2d session sources and every single-edit mutation of them.

files.doc: /** 📤️ The retained, ephemeral, fresh turn, host only, config and presence publication contract checks. */

phases.name: retainedPublicationChecks
phases.doc: Checks the retained store and plugin publication bounds.

phases.name: ephemeralPublicationChecks
phases.doc: Checks the retained ephemeral one item publication and publisher bounds.

phases.name: freshTurnAndHostOnlyPublicationChecks
phases.doc: Checks publication freshness before every turn and the host only, config and presence publication contracts.

files.doc: /** 🛑️ The cancellation, runtime close, snapshot, reactor and segmented output ownership checks. */

phases.name: typedRouteCancellationAndCloseChecks
phases.doc: Checks typed route guards, cancellation handle shapes, close witnesses, runtime close budgets and live cleanup ownership.

phases.name: snapshotAndReactorCloseChecks
phases.doc: Checks snapshot retirement witnesses, owned disposers and reactor close, admission and starvation.

phases.name: segmentedOutputAndChildRootChecks
phases.doc: Checks segmented output chunks, media output credit, operation roots and the fixed child registry.

files.doc: /** 🗄️ The artifact store structural owner, history ledger, edit message ledger and owned envelope codec checks. */

phases.name: artifactStoreStructuralAndEnvelopeCodecChecks
phases.doc: Checks the structural store owners, the VCS history reservation, the edit message ledger and the owned envelope codec callers.

files.doc: /** ✍️ The writer, jack, trinity rewrite and gis map caller retained document envelope checks. */

phases.name: writerEnvelopeCallerRetainedChecks
phases.doc: Checks the writer envelope caller retained route and returns the writer sources the other documents derive from.

phases.name: jackEnvelopeCallerRetainedChecks
phases.doc: Checks the jack envelope caller retained route.

phases.name: trinityRewriteEnvelopeCallerRetainedChecks
phases.doc: Checks the trinity rewrite envelope caller retained route.

phases.name: gisMapEnvelopeCallerRetainedChecks
phases.doc: Checks the gis map envelope caller retained route.

files.doc: /** 🖼️ The raster envelope caller retained sources and their route, mutation, loop restoration and rejected output identity checks. */

phases.name: rasterEnvelopeSourceFixtures
phases.doc: Builds the raster codec and editor sources.

phases.name: rasterEnvelopeRouteAndMutationChecks
phases.doc: Checks the raster envelope route, signature suspension and single-edit mutations.

phases.name: rasterEnvelopeLoopRestorationChecks
phases.doc: Checks that restoring a whole loop in the raster serializers is refused.

phases.name: rasterRejectedOutputIdentityChecks
phases.doc: Checks the rejected output identity, binding and retirement order of the raster parameter and asset maps.

files.doc: /** 🎨️ The drawing envelope caller retained sources and their route, semantic digest and mutation checks. */

phases.name: drawingEnvelopeSourceFixtures
phases.doc: Builds the drawing codec and editor sources.

phases.name: drawingEnvelopeRouteAndSemanticChecks
phases.doc: Checks the drawing envelope route, the production editor and the semantic digest field omissions.

phases.name: drawingEnvelopeMutationChecks
phases.doc: Checks the drawing single-edit mutations of the codec, the editor and the plugin sources.

files.doc: /** 🤝️ The peer presence roster, the paged command ingress and the kernel request queue checks. */

phases.name: peerPresenceRosterChecks
phases.doc: Checks that the peer presence roster stays fixed, typed, validated and committed with its generation.

phases.name: commandIngressAndKernelRequestChecks
phases.doc: Checks the paged command ingress, the command batch owners and the kernel request and close queues.

files.doc: /** 🔭️ The universal retained session ownership and the layout export and cold relay retained ownership checks. */

phases.name: universalRetainedOwnershipChecks
phases.doc: Checks the job, native I/O, wgpu and animate retained session ownership and every single-edit mutation of them.

phases.name: layoutAndColdRelayRetainedChecks
phases.doc: Checks the layout export, layout wasm and guest cold relay retained ownership.
